score: max over ALL the agent's topics of TopicEvidence.raw_score (the topic's evidence_aggregate of its probe_k similarities, without evidence_bias)
caveats: The 'in' queries were written looking at the documents: in-domain recall and AUROC are optimistic.
A threshold is valid only for the corpus snapshot, tenant, embedding model and profiles in meta: recalibrate after a re-ingest. Changing a rule needs a fresh OOD set.
rule: p95 of the 'out' scores (pre-registered); 'in' only reports recall
